name: Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad

source.title: Alliance Bank quarterly report Q1 FY2027

oneLine: A mid-sized Malaysian bank focused on small and medium businesses and consumers.
inPlainWords: Alliance Bank lends to small and medium businesses and to individuals, all in Malaysia.
Business banking earns most of its profit.
It has a relatively high share of low-cost current and savings deposits.

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Business Banking
segments.desc: Loans and cash management for SMEs and companies

segments.name: Consumer Banking
segments.desc: Mortgages, personal loans, cards and deposits for individuals

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q1 FY2027 report p.37).

aiImages.caption: Deposits: savers' money kept safe and paid a return
Interest and fees: what borrowers and customers pay the bank
Loans: money lent so homes, cars and businesses can grow
